nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.true_soul_co: True Soul Corpse Magic: Rades Spirito's pact. Arms a ten minute pact (sneak and use on up to three players to bind them), re-raises the pets and summons that fell a moment ago as Soul Zombies, and a bound ally who would die is brought back at a price. Rades Spirito's grimoire only.
